code:
import oge

# 初始化
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# 读取指定范围内的多景 DEM
dem_collection = service.getCoverageCollection(
    productID="ASTER_GDEM_DEM30",
    datetime=["2000-01-01 00:00:00,2000-01-01 00:00:00"],
    bbox=[108.5, 18.1, 111.0, 20.1]
)

# 1) 多景 DEM 镶嵌，形成连续 DEM 表面
dem = service.getProcess("CoverageCollection.mosaic").execute(
    dem_collection,
    "mean"
)

# 2) 对连续 DEM 做基础平滑，抑制局部噪声
dem_base = service.getProcess("Coverage.focalMean").execute(
    dem,
    "square",
    1
)

# 3) 基于处理后的 DEM 生成地形阴影结果
hillshade = service.getProcess("Coverage.terrHillshade").execute(
    dem_base,
    1,
    1
)

# 可视化参数
dem_vis = {
    "palette": ["#274e13", "#5b8a3c", "#b7b26a", "#d9c59a", "#f5f5f5"]
}

shade_vis = {
    "palette": ["#1f1f1f", "#555555", "#8a8a8a", "#c0c0c0", "#f2f2f2"]
}

# 输出结果：处理后的连续 DEM 与阴影结果对照展示
dem_base.styles(dem_vis).getMap("dem_base")
hillshade.styles(shade_vis).getMap("hillshade")

# 设置地图中心
oge.mapclient.centerMap(109.7, 19.1, 9)

code:
import oge

oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# =========================
# 1. 读取两景 ALOS DEM
# =========================
dem1 = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="n030e110",
    productID="ALOS_PALSAR_DEM12.5"
)
dem2 = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="n030e111",
    productID="ALOS_PALSAR_DEM12.5"
)

# =========================
# 2. 合并并镶嵌为连续 DEM
# =========================
dem_collection = service.getProcess(
    "CoverageCollection.mergeCoverages"
).execute([dem1, dem2], ["dem1", "dem2"])

dem_mosaic = service.getProcess(
    "CoverageCollection.mosaic"
).execute(dem_collection)

# =========================
# 3. 计算坡度
# 采用 terrSlope，按当前已有经验使用 radius=1, z-factor=9.5e-06
# =========================
slope = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.terrSlope"
).execute(dem_mosaic, 1, 9.5e-06)

# =========================
# 4. 高程分带
# 0-300m   -> 1 低位带
# 300-800m -> 2 中位带
# 800m+    -> 3 高位带
# =========================
NaN_value = 0

elev_rules = [
    (0.0, 300.0, 1.0),
    (300.0, 800.0, 2.0),
    (800.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

elev_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(dem_mosaic, elev_rules)

# =========================
# 5. 坡度分级
# 0-8°   -> 1 平缓坡
# 8-20°  -> 2 起伏坡
# 20-90° -> 3 陡坡
# =========================
slope_rules = [
    (0.0, 8.0, 1.0),
    (8.0, 20.0, 2.0),
    (20.0, 90.0, 3.0)
]

slope_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(slope, slope_rules)

# =========================
# 6. 联合编码
# 联合编码 = 高程类别 * 10 + 坡度类别
# 得到 11,12,13,21,22,23,31,32,33
# =========================
elev_class_x10 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(elev_class, 10)

combined_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(elev_class_x10, slope_class)

# =========================
# 7. 归并为 4 类基础地形层次带
# 11 -> 1 低位平缓带
# 12,13,21 -> 2 低中位过渡带
# 22,23,31 -> 3 中高位起伏带
# 32,33 -> 4 高位陡峻带
# =========================
terrain_rules = [
    (10.5, 11.5, 1.0),  # 11

    (11.5, 13.5, 2.0),  # 12,13
    (20.5, 21.5, 2.0),  # 21

    (21.5, 23.5, 3.0),  # 22,23
    (30.5, 31.5, 3.0),  # 31

    (31.5, 33.5, 4.0)   # 32,33
]

terrain_band = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(combined_class, terrain_rules)

# =========================
# 8. 轻量整理最终层次带结果
# 使用 focalMode 减少局部碎斑
# =========================
terrain_band_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMode"
).execute(terrain_band, "circle", 1)

# =========================
# 9. 可视化
# =========================

dem = service.getCoverage(

)

# 2. DEM 轻量平滑
# 既保留区域地形结构，又减少局部噪声

# =========================

# 用于识别明显不利的陡坡区域

    "Coverage.terrSlope"
).execute(dem_base, 1, 9.5e-06)

# 坡度等级：

    (8.0, 18.0, 2.0),
    (18.0, 90.0, 3.0)
]

# 修复：移除多余的 NaN_value 参数
slope_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(slope, slope_rules)

# =========================
# 4. 局部起伏（局部高差）
# 用于识别起伏过强区域
# =========================

).execute(dem_base, "circle", 9)

).execute(relief, "circle", 2)

# 起伏等级：

# 2 = 一般

relief_rules = [
    (0.0, 40.0, 1.0),
    (40.0, 100.0, 2.0),
    (100.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(relief_smooth, relief_rules)

    "Coverage.focalMean"

# =========================

description: 请结合 NDVI 和地表温度数据计算温度植被干旱指数（TVDI），并把结果在地图上展示出来。
code:
import oge

oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# ============================================================
# 1. 读取Landsat Collection 2 Level-2数据
# ============================================================
landsat_l2 = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LC09_L2SP_125023_20211031_20230507_02_T1",
    productID="LC09_C02_L2"
)

landsat_l2 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.toFloat"
).execute(landsat_l2)

# ============================================================
# 2. 提取红光、近红外和地表温度波段
# 使用波段号：SR_B4、SR_B5、ST_B10
# ============================================================
red_dn = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.selectBands"
).execute(landsat_l2, ["SR_B4"])

nir_dn = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.selectBands"
).execute(landsat_l2, ["SR_B5"])

st_dn = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.selectBands"
).execute(landsat_l2, ["ST_B10"])

# ============================================================
# 3. Collection 2 Level-2地表反射率定标
#
# Reflectance = DN × 0.0000275 - 0.2
# ============================================================
red = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(red_dn, 0.0000275)

red = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(red, -0.2)

nir = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(nir_dn, 0.0000275)

nir = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(nir, -0.2)

# ============================================================
# 4. 使用定标后的反射率计算NDVI
#
# NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red)
#
# 由于反射率存在-0.2偏移，不能直接在原始DN上调用
# normalizedDifference，因此手动计算。
# ============================================================
ndvi_num = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(nir, red)

ndvi_den = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(nir, red)

ndvi = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.divide"
).execute(ndvi_num, ndvi_den)

# ============================================================
# 5. Collection 2 Level-2地表温度定标
#
# LST(K) = DN × 0.00341802 + 149
# LST(℃) = LST(K) - 273.15
# ============================================================
lst_k = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(st_dn, 0.00341802)

lst_k = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(lst_k, 149.0)

lst_c = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtractNum"
).execute(lst_k, 273.15)

# ============================================================
# 6. 构造NDVI-LST湿边和干边
#
# 湿边：Twet = 25 - 10 × NDVI
# 干边：Tdry = 45 - 5 × NDVI
#
# 这些参数适合作为代码Demo参数。
# 定量研究时应从当前场景的NDVI-LST散点空间拟合。
# ============================================================
wet_edge = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(ndvi, -10.0)

wet_edge = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(wet_edge, 25.0)

dry_edge = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(ndvi, -5.0)

dry_edge = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(dry_edge, 45.0)

# ============================================================
# 7. 计算TVDI
#
# TVDI = (LST - Twet) / (Tdry - Twet)
# ============================================================
tvdi_num = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(lst_c, wet_edge)

tvdi_den = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(dry_edge, wet_edge)

tvdi = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.divide"
).execute(tvdi_num, tvdi_den)

# ============================================================
# 8. 地图展示
# ============================================================
tvdi_vis = {
    "min": 0,
    "max": 1,
    "palette": [
        "#0000ff",
        "#00ffff",
        "#00ff00",
        "#ffff00",
        "#ffa500",
        "#ff0000",
        "#800000"
    ]
}

tvdi.styles(tvdi_vis).getMap("温度植被干旱指数 TVDI")


# 影像中心点位可视化
oge.mapclient.centerMap(118.86948458090001,53.085515813,11)

description: 我想综合提取武汉市汉南区及周边区域的主要道路、水体和耕地，并减少水体与耕地解译结果中的零碎图斑。请基于同一幅武汉一号高分辨率影像，并行调用主干道提取、水体提取和耕地提取模型；分别计算水体和耕地图斑的面积，过滤面积较小的零碎图斑；然后为主干道、筛选后的水体和耕地添加统一的地物类别属性，将三类结果合并为一份综合解译矢量图层，并使用批处理模式导出。
code:
import oge

# 初始化
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service.initialize()

# 读取武汉一号高分辨率影像
coverage = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LJ3II_MSS_E114.07_N30.36_20241221_L1A_010_GS",
    productID="LJ3II_PAN_MSS"
)

# ==================================================
# 1. 三个模型并行提取地物
# ==================================================

# 主干道提取
roads = service.getProcess(
    "whu-mainroad"
).execute(coverage)

# 水体提取
water_raw = service.getProcess(
    "whu01_water"
).execute(coverage)

# 耕地提取
cultivated_land_raw = service.getProcess(
    "whu-cultivated_land"
).execute(coverage)

# ==================================================
# 2. 优化水体提取结果
# ==================================================

# 计算水体图斑面积
water_with_area = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.area"
).execute(
    water_raw,
    "geom"
)

# 过滤面积较小的零碎水体图斑
water_filtered = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.filterMetadata"
).execute(
    water_with_area,
    "area",
    "greater_than",
    "0.00000005"
)

# ==================================================
# 3. 优化耕地提取结果
# ==================================================

# 计算耕地图斑面积
cultivated_land_with_area = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.area"
).execute(
    cultivated_land_raw,
    "geom"
)

# 过滤面积较小的零碎耕地图斑
cultivated_land_filtered = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.filterMetadata"
).execute(
    cultivated_land_with_area,
    "area",
    "greater_than",
    "0.00000005"
)

# 4. 为三类地物添加统一类别属性
# ==================================================

roads_labeled = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.constantColumn"
).execute(
    roads,
    "land_type",
    "main_road"
)

water_labeled = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.constantColumn"
).execute(
    water_filtered,
    "land_type",
    "water"
)

cultivated_land_labeled = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.constantColumn"
).execute(
    cultivated_land_filtered,
    "land_type",
    "cultivated_land"
)

# ==================================================
# 5. 合并三类地物结果
# ==================================================

road_water = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.merge"
).execute(
    roads_labeled,
    water_labeled
)

comprehensive_interpretation = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.merge"
).execute(
    road_water,
    cultivated_land_labeled
)

comprehensive_interpretation.export(

)
